name: @phux/opencode-v2
description: OpenCode V2 plugin: phux owns the terminals, OpenCode owns the session

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile index.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode/plugin && bun build src/tui.ts --outfile tui.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode/plugin/tui --external solid-js
scripts.gates: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun test
